hamburg-north-german-escapes-wingst-fore.title: Wingst Forest and Elbe Ferry Loop
hamburg-north-german-escapes-wingst-fore.slogan: A 557 km loop out of Hamburg west edge
hamburg-north-german-escapes-wingst-fore.story: A compact ride with forest shade, ferries and enough texture. Out of Hamburg and back again: 557 km, roughly 10 h 08 in the saddle. On the way it passes Wingst, Bomlitz, Elbe and Hermannsburg. Much of it runs through woodland.

scenicChapters.title: Ödenahlen → Schreckensee
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
